name: SteelPrime LSF maquete — GOLDEN FINAL (operator cuts for production)
status: CANONICAL — use for all future LSF house maquetes of this pattern

geometry.description: Each LSF member as solid oriented box ~1.9mm min section; single flat base; operator production cuts

pipeline_for_future_houses: 2. Scale to maquete (1:70 then fit bed ~0.76 or fit H2D)
3. Per-member solid OBB with min cross-section ~1.9 mm (NOT global voxel solid)
4. Drop low foundation mega-slabs; single flat base 2.5 mm
5. Optional operator cuts in Bambu for production optimization
6. Apply H2D LSF print profile (tree support, walls 3, brim 8)
7. Freeze resulting 3mf as project golden if approved
forbidden: Global voxel fill / marching cubes of whole house (Minecraft mass)
Thousands of vertical posts under every member
Min thickness below ~1.5–1.8 mm on 0.4 nozzle
lessons: Visual LSF fidelity requires multi-body members, not one solid
Printability requires min section ~1.9 mm on 0.4 nozzle with walls 3
Tree support ON, on build plate only OFF
Operator production cuts in Bambu are valid finalization step
